title: Burnham should fight next election on promise to rejoin EU, says Peter Kyle
summary_full: Exclusive: Former business secretary calls for Labour manifesto commitment with referendum on final decisionAndy Burnham should fight the next election on a promise to rejoin the EU, the former business secretary Peter Kyle has said, with voters given a referendum on the outcome of any deal.The Labour MP, a key member of Keir Starmer’s cabinet, said the “only way through” the challenges of the domestic political debate was for the government to offer voters the choice to accept or reject any agreement.On Tuesday 1 December, join John Crace and Pippa Crerar as they skewer the biggest stories from Westminster and beyond, as part of the Guardian’s year in review event. Joined by fellow Guardian writers, expect candid conversations, witty remarks and surprises as they look back on the year-defining stories of 2026.
